summary: Route Finder now finds any real airline flight, not just those airborne, with airport filters and a flight-time slider. Desktop updates now prompt on launch and install inside the app.
releaseNotes: Route Finder searches every known real airline route; FLYING NOW limits it to flights airborne right now.
Route Finder filters by departure and arrival airport.
Flight time is a slider from 30 minutes to 21 hours.
On Windows, Update Now downloads the new version, checks its published checksum, installs it and reopens Stratos.
The desktop app now detects new releases: it read the version file packaged with itself and always thought it was current.
Removed the DIRECT TO button from the EFB and Flight Deck, and the TRK button from the Flight Deck.
Installs of 2.2.1 or older must update to 2.2.2 by hand once; later updates are offered in the app.
